label: Diagram 8
caption: Diagram 8 Pipe runs near buildings
description:
The image is titled 'Diagram 8 Pipe runs near buildings' and contains two separate cross-sectional drawings arranged vertically. Both show the wall of a building standing on a strip foundation, with a pipe trench beside it. In the upper drawing, a line indicates 'Ground level'. A horizontal double-headed arrow labelled 'A' measures the distance from the edge of the foundation to the side of the trench on the right. A horizontal dashed line runs from the underside of the foundation to the trench. Text below reads 'Where A is less than 1m concrete fill trench to this level'. The trench is filled with concrete up to that level, with the pipe at its base.

The lower drawing shows a similar arrangement with a horizontal arrow labelled 'A'. A vertical double-headed arrow labelled 'A less 150mm' measures down from the dashed line at the underside of the foundation to a lower level in the trench. Text below reads 'Where A is 1m or more concrete fill trench to this level'. Below that level the trench holds the pipe in its fill.

In the upper drawing, a line indicates 'Ground level'. A horizontal double-headed arrow labelled 'A' measures the distance from the pipes to the edge of a deep cut-out on the right. A horizontal dashed line runs across the upper part of the cut-out. Text below reads 'Where A is less than 1m concrete fill trench to this level'. The cut-out contains loose material and a pipe at its base. 

The lower drawing shows a similar arrangement with pipes through a slab and a horizontal arrow labelled 'A'. A vertical double-headed arrow is labelled 'A less 150mm', measuring from the dashed line down to the bottom of a second deep cut-out. Text below reads 'Where A is 1m or more concrete fill trench to this level'. This cut-out also contains loose material and a pipe at the bottom.

check.note: Calls the walls on their foundations "vertical pipes passing through a slab". A and the two fill levels are right.
